name: Bluefield State University
oos_note: Public university. Non-resident tuition & fees from bluefieldstate.edu/tuition-and-fees, Fall 2026/Spring 2027 schedule: $8,688/semester full-time (12 hrs) x 2 = $17,376/year. Resident rate on same page = $4,824/sem x 2 = $9,648/year, matching the known in-state figure, confirming the basis (tuition & fees, excluding room/board).
